VERSION.value: github.com/takyamamoto/Hopfield-Network master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)

value.lineage: The Hopfield network (Hopfield 1982): a recurrent associative memory where patterns are stored as attractors of an energy function; presented a corrupted pattern, the dynamics descend the energy landscape and recall the nearest stored memory

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: content-addressable (associative) memory with error correction by attractor dynamics

value.built_to: store patterns as stable attractors and RECALL the nearest stored pattern from a noisy or partial cue by iterating recurrent dynamics that minimise an energy function
value.pressure: recall from corrupted/partial input, and a hard capacity limit (~0.14N patterns) beyond which memories interfere and recall fails
value.success_means: a corrupted cue converges to the correct stored pattern; the network denoises and completes

value.pressure: noisy/partial input, bounded storage capacity, spurious attractors
value.failure_condition: above capacity (or with correlated patterns) it converges to a spurious/wrong attractor -- recalls a memory that was never stored
